description: The expiry boundary, payout time to live, cancellation after expiry, and reactivation by extending expires_at.

vectors.description: One second before expires_at a payout is requested, approved and executed, and expires one time to live after its request.
At exactly expires_at requests, approvals and execution are refused, free is the whole balance, and a rejection still works.
After expiry the principal and the requesting agent cancel at once, and anyone else once the payout's own time to live has run.
Extending expires_at after expiry, with the reservations covered, makes the mandate active again and its open payout executable.
After expiry the principal withdraws everything, so extending is refused until the reservations are cancelled.
After expiry and a full withdrawal, extending is refused one unit short of the reservations and accepted once they are covered.
A third party sweeps after the grace, so extending is refused until anyone cancels the lapsed reservations.
A payout expires one time to live after its request, a later change of the time to live does not move it, and new requests take the new value.
An attested payout expires at the earlier of its time to live and its attestation's valid_until, and executes in its last second.
At its attestation's valid_until an attested payout has lapsed, cannot execute, and anyone may cancel it.
